name: Cone Marching
definition: An optimization for ray marching where bundles of rays are grouped into a cone to skip repeated SDF calculations. The cone is marched in the vertex shader (or a coarser pass), and the resulting distance/steps are passed to the fragment shader to resume ray marching from that point.
summary: Cone Marching optimizes ray marching by grouping rays into cones for coarse vertex-shader advancement, reducing fragment shader Signed Distance Function evaluations.
